feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 September 2026 11:49am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 01 September 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and west of the British Isles. High pressure over northwest France, transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 for a time in the west this evening, slowly backing overnight & tomorrow morning to South or Southeast 3 or 4 in most waters.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

A few showers in the far north of the area at first. Scattered showers later today, then rain spreading from the west tonight & tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good today, falling moderate or poor in rain tonight & tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast or South 3 to 5, veering Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then West at night, backing Southwest on Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain, soon slowly clearing to showers tomorrow afternoon, mostly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in places at first.
